theater: 喀布爾與興都庫什山區

battle.name: 阿富汗戰爭
battle.theater: 喀布爾與興都庫什山區
battle.brief: 二〇〇一年十月七日聯軍發動持久自由行動，先以巡弋飛彈、隱形轟炸機與戰機摧毀塔利班的空軍與防空，地面由北方聯盟南北對進。卡面是M4卡賓槍：二〇〇一年已取代M16成為美軍步兵班主力，五百米內的有效射程同全自動射擊，正好應付興都庫什山區的短射程遭遇戰。

kit.name: M4卡賓槍
kit.history: 1994年定型，2001年部署至阿富汗山區，取代M16。

countries: 交戰一方是以美國為主的北約與多國聯盟：由美國中央司令部統一指揮，第101空降師、第82空降師與第五特種部隊群負責南部戰區，第173空降旅負責西部，第10山地師與英國皇家空降兵等部隊控制北部；英國由國防部戰略行動指揮部統籌，設持久自由行動英軍指揮部，法國投入第14步兵師與外國作戰司令部，加拿大、澳洲、紐西蘭、德國第31空降旅、義大利、西班牙、荷蘭、丹麥、波蘭、土耳其、日本等國先後派兵或提供空域、後勤與情報支援，先後參與的國家接近五十個。北方聯盟與後來的阿富汗臨時政府得到美國中央情報局與巴基斯坦情報局配合：普什圖武裝首領阿卜杜勒·拉蘇爾·薩耶夫率北線沿白沙瓦走廊南下，馬蘇德留下的塔吉克部隊自東北向喀布爾推進，卡扎伊率南方聯盟攻向坎大哈，多斯圖姆的烏茲別克武裝攻入沙伊-科特；另一方是塔利班，其精神領袖穆罕默德·奧馬爾毛拉坐鎮坎大哈，阿里·汗·阿洪德毛拉掌軍權，奧巴杜拉毛拉主持情報與特務，法制沙基卜·哈基米執行伊斯蘭法，基地組織與巴基斯坦武裝分子亦參戰。二〇〇三年起北約接過戰線，組建國際安全援助部隊並設聯合部隊司令部，二〇一四年撤出戰鬥任務、二〇一五年改為果斷支援、二〇一七年再改為訓練顧問協助。
countriesEn: One side of the conflict was the United States-led NATO and multinational coalition. United States Central Command directed the campaign: the 101st and 82nd Airborne Divisions with the 5th Special Forces Group took the southern theater, the 173rd Airborne Brigade covered the west, and the 10th Mountain Division, the British Parachute Regiment and other units controlled the north. Britain ran its contingent through the Defence Staff Strategic Operations Centre and Joint Forces Command, France committed the 14th Infantry Division and the Foreign Operations Command, and Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Germany's 31st Air Assault Brigade, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Denmark, Poland, Turkey and Japan supplied troops, airfields, logistics or intelligence, with close to fifty nations involved over the campaign. The Northern Alliance and the later Afghan interim government worked with the American Central Intelligence Agency and Pakistan's Inter-Services Intelligence: the Pashtun warlord Abdul Rasul Sayyaf drove the northern thrust down the Peshawar corridor, Massoud's former Tajik columns pushed south from the northeast toward Kabul, Hamid Karzai led the southern alliance against Kandahar, and Abdul Rashid Dostum's Uzbek forces struck into the Shah-i-Kot valley. Against them stood the Taliban, whose spiritual leader Mullah Mohammed Omar held court in Kandahar, whose defence minister Mullah Akhund exercised real power, whose intelligence chief Mullah Obaidullah ran the security apparatus, and whose justice minister Mullah Fazel Hakimi enforced Islamic law, with al-Qaeda and Pakistani militants also taking part. From 2003 NATO took over the line, forming the International Security Assistance Force and a Joint Command; it ended its combat mission in 2014, became Resolute Support in 2015 and finally Train Advise Assist in 2017.
people: 關鍵人物分屬三邊。美國方面，總統喬治·布希在九一一事變後數日內便決定用兵，副總統迪克·切尼與國防部長唐納德·拉姆斯菲爾德主張大規模空襲，參謀長科林·鮑威爾與國家安全顧問康狄·賴斯主導戰略，聯軍中央司令部由湯姆·弗蘭克斯中將指揮，第101空降師師長約翰·弗蘭克斯少將統率喀布爾方向，第187空降團團長雷金納德·恩哈特上校率部奪取坎大哈，特別作戰主任馬克·納奇上尉帶領首批北方聯盟突擊隊。塔利班方面，創辦人兼精神領袖穆罕默德·奧馬爾毛拉自一九九六年起主持政權，十月二十一日乘車經阿爾甘達布山口撤出城區，此後再未公開露面；國防部長阿里·汗·阿洪德毛拉是實權人物，總參謀長奧巴杜拉毛拉控制軍情與情報，法制沙基卜·哈基米代表法權；影子政府一端，二〇一六年後由穆罕默德·哈桑·阿洪德主持，二〇二一年交由阿赫塔爾·穆罕默德·曼蘇爾。北方聯盟方面，薩耶夫掌控北線與白沙瓦周邊的普什圖部族，馬蘇德一九九九年遇刺身亡、未能指揮二〇〇一年的戰役，其子哈桑·齊亞與拉赫曼·巴巴爾延續其部隊，卡扎伊以南方聯盟領袖身分入主喀布爾，多斯圖姆以果決聞名；巴基斯坦總統佩爾韋茲·穆沙拉夫與陸軍參謀長阿什法克·帕爾韋茲·卡亞尼提供空域、基地與貫穿全戰線的補給通道。
peopleEn: The decisive figures line up on three sides. On the American side, President George W. Bush decided on the use of force within days of 9/11, with Vice President Dick Cheney and Defense Secretary Donald Rumsfeld pressing for a large air campaign; Chief of Staff Colin Powell and National Security Advisor Condoleezza Rice shaped the strategy, the joint command ran under General Tommy Franks at Central Command, Major General John Franks commanded the 101st Airborne Division in the Kabul drive, Colonel Reginald Earnhardt led the 187th Airborne Regiment that took Kandahar, and Special Forces Captain Mark Nutsch headed the first Northern Alliance strike teams. On the Taliban side, founder and spiritual leader Mullah Mohammed Omar had ruled from Kandahar since 1996 and left the city by vehicle through the Arghandab passes on 21 October, never to appear in public again; defence minister Mullah Akhund was the real power, intelligence chief Mullah Obaidullah controlled the security services, and justice minister Mullah Fazel Hakimi enforced the Islamic law; in the shadow government, Mullah Mohammad Hasan Akhund took over in 2016 and was succeeded in 2021 by Akhtar Mohammad Mansur. On the Northern Alliance side, Sayyaf held the northern front and the Pashtun belt around Peshawar, Ahmad Shah Massoud, assassinated in 1999, could not command the 2001 campaign though his son Hassan Zia and Rajab Babur carried on his columns, Karzai entered Kabul as leader of the southern alliance, and Dostum was known throughout the alliance for ruthlessness; in Pakistan, President Pervez Musharraf and Army Chief Ashfaq Parvez Kayani provided the airspace, the bases and the supply corridor that tied the whole campaign together.
kits: 卡面兵器是M4卡賓槍：一支一九九四年定型的5.56×45mm北約步槍，配三十發STANAG彈匣，無托型槍托全槍重約二點八八公斤，改配固定照門長槍托約三點四公斤，有效射程約三百至五百米，可加掛M203 40毫米榴彈發射器，二〇〇二年後推出帶導軌與瞄具的M4 SOPMOD。二〇〇一年十月，第101空降師與特別作戰部隊是最早換裝的單位，卡賓槍比M16A2輕一半以上，在海拔兩三千米的山區便於攜行，也讓步兵班在狹窄山徑上能迅速指向射擊；其5.56毫米彈藥在高原因空氣稀薄、膛壓下降，初速與有效射程都要打折，這正是後期改用M855彈藥並加強7.62毫米選項的理由。同期美軍火力骨幹還有M249班機槍、M240通用機槍、M2重機槍、MK19 40毫米自動榴彈發射器、標槍反裝甲飛彈與MAAWS，空中支援由AH-64阿帕契、UH-60黑鷹、CH-47支奴干擔當，裝備有M1艾布拉姆斯主戰坦克、M2布萊德利步兵戰車、悍馬與MRAP防地雷車。塔利班與北方聯盟沿用蘇聯遺產：AK-47與AKS-74U步槍、PKM通用機槍、DShK重機槍、RPG-7火箭筒、SPAS-15霰彈槍；蘇聯在一九八〇年代售予阿富汗的軍火估值達數十億美元，其中最有名的是肩射防空導彈——二〇〇一年十月二十八日，塔利班以這類導彈擊落一架巴基斯坦空軍F-16戰機，飛行員生還。
kitsEn: The card's weapon is the M4 carbine: a 5.56×45mm NATO rifle finalized in 1994, fed by 30-round STANAG magazines, weighing about 2.88 kg with its collapsible stock, or roughly 3.4 kg with the fixed long carry handle, with an effective range of roughly 300 to 500 metres, able to take the M203 40 mm grenade launcher, and later joined by the rail-equipped, optic-bearing M4 SOPMOD. In October 2001 the 101st Airborne Division and the special forces units were the first to re-equip; the carbine weighed less than half of the M16A2, which mattered when carrying ammunition over ridges at two and three thousand metres, and it let a squad point and shoot quickly on narrow trails. Its 5.56 mm ammunition suffered in the thin air of the highlands, where lower chamber pressure cut muzzle velocity and effective range, and that was the reason for the later switch to M855 loads and 7.62 mm options. The rest of the American firepower backbone ran from the M249 squad automatic rifle, the M240 general-purpose machine gun, the M2 heavy machine gun, the Mk 19 40 mm automatic grenade launcher, the Javelin anti-armour missile and MAAWS, with AH-64 Apache, UH-60 Black Hawk and CH-47 Chinook helicopters providing air support, and M1 Abrams tanks, M2 Bradley infantry fighting vehicles, Humvees and MRAP mine-resistant vehicles carrying the infantry. The Taliban and the Northern Alliance inherited Soviet matériel: AK-47 and AKS-74U rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, DShK heavy machine guns, RPG-7 rocket launchers and SPAS-15 shotguns. The Soviet arms sales of the 1980s were valued in the billions of dollars, and the most famous item among them was the man-portable air-defence missile: on 28 October 2001 the Taliban used one of these to shoot down a Pakistan Air Force F-16, whose pilot survived.
tactics: 開局是純粹的空中殲滅：十月七日聯軍以B-2隱形轟炸機、巡弋飛彈、戰機與轟炸機群摧毀巴格拉姆、坎大哈、賈拉拉巴德等地的空軍基地與防空體系，北方聯盟再沿山脈縱隊南北對進，形成空中火力加地面縱隊的兩面夾擊。托拉波拉的洞穴戰與山脊封鎖顯示地形主導一切：步兵以M4在山脊兩側據守，火力支援只能靠少量直升機冒險進入谷地，制高點與洞口決定勝負。二〇〇二年三月的蟒蛇行動與山巒突擊則是空降深入配合裝甲：北方聯盟部隊與特種部隊乘UH-60與CH-47躍進沙伊-科特山谷，突擊Qala-i-Jangi堡壘，以迫擊砲與武裝直升機封住出口，再用T-55坦克逐段清剿。城鎮戰與外圍清剿成為日常：塔利班慣於在村莊外設伏、襲擊巡邏隊與補給線，聯軍遂改採外圈封鎖，以觀察哨控制進出路，發現敵情即以M4、標槍與迫擊砲反應，再由空襲配合地面突擊。北約在二〇〇五年後推廣英國式營連基地、德國式快速反應突擊與美軍的前進作戰基地，並與阿富汗國民警察的據點守衛結合，形成清空、佔領、建設的循環。到二〇一四年聯軍撤退前，北約已改為只在塔利班占據的鄉村發動大規模清剿，兵力以營為單位集中，避免分散在據點被游擊消耗。
tacticsEn: The opening was pure air annihilation: on 7 October the coalition flew B-2 stealth bombers, cruise missiles, fighters and strike aircraft against the airbases and air defences at Bagram, Kandahar, Jalalabad and elsewhere, and the Northern Alliance then drove north and south along the mountain valleys, creating a two-pronged pincer of air power and ground columns. The cave country of Tora Bora showed how terrain dictated everything: infantry held ridges with M4s, air support could only risk a few helicopters into the valley, and the high ground and the cave mouths decided the fight. Operation Anaconda and Operation Mountain Thrust in March 2002 combined air assault with armour: Northern Alliance troops and special forces rode in by UH-60 and CH-47 into the Shah-i-Kot valley, struck the Qala-i-Jangi fortress, sealed the exits with mortars and gunship fire, and cleared the position yard by yard with T-55 tanks. Urban fighting and clearing the countryside became the daily routine: the Taliban habitually ambushed patrols and supply columns outside the villages, so the coalition switched to holding the outer ring, with observation posts controlling every approach, M4s, Javelins and mortars reacting at the first contact, and air strikes supporting the ground assault. From 2005 NATO promoted the British battlegroup base, the German quick reaction strike force and American forward operating bases, combined with Afghan Local Police manning the population centres, producing a cycle of clear, hold and build. By the time the coalition withdrew in 2014, NATO was concentrating its troops in battalion-sized columns against Taliban-held countryside rather than dispersing them among static outposts where insurgents could wear them down.
data: 可考的數字：二〇〇一年十月七日首日，聯軍發射數十枚巡弋飛彈並出動數十架次戰機與轟炸機，打擊四座主要空軍基地與數十個目標；頭三個月聯軍空中出動逾一萬架次，約三分之一為攻擊架次。二〇〇一年十月二十八日一架巴基斯坦空軍F-16被塔利班肩射防空導彈擊落，飛行員生還，這是塔利班唯一一次在空中擊落有人飛行器；全戰爭期間聯軍固定翼飛機未曾在空戰中被塔利班擊落，但地面火箭彈曾擊落UH-60直升機，例如二〇一一年興都庫什山區一次事件造成三十名美軍死亡。兵力方面，美軍在二〇一一年達到約十萬人峰值，北約盟軍總兵力在二〇一〇至二〇一一年間約十三萬人；美軍先後有超過八十萬人輪換部署，全美曾派往相關地區者逾二百萬人。代價方面，美國直接軍費估計約2.3萬億美元，加計債務利息與退伍軍人照顧接近3萬億美元；全球各地因二〇〇一年後美國海外戰爭付出的經濟代價合計超過5萬億美元。聯合國二〇二一年評估：塔利班武裝人員在戰爭中死亡約五萬至五萬五千人，北方聯盟與阿富汗政府軍損失約一萬至一萬四千人。二〇二一年八月三十日美軍完成撤離，戰爭歷時近二十年，是美國史上持續最久的戰爭。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked: on 7 October 2001 the coalition fired dozens of cruise missiles and flew dozens of fighter and bomber sorties on the first day, hitting four main airfields and dozens of targets; in the first three months coalition aircraft flew more than ten thousand sorties, about a third of them strike missions. On 28 October 2001 a Pakistan Air Force F-16 was shot down by a Taliban shoulder-fired air-defence missile and the pilot survived, the only manned aircraft the Taliban ever destroyed in flight. No coalition fixed-wing aircraft was ever lost to the Taliban in air combat over the whole war, though ground-launched rockets did bring down helicopters, as in a 2011 engagement in the Hindu Kush that killed thirty Americans. On troop numbers, the American force peaked at about 100,000 men in 2011 and total NATO strength was around 130,000 between 2010 and 2011; more than 800,000 American personnel rotated through the country and over two million Americans served in the region overall. In money, American direct military costs are estimated at about 2.3 trillion dollars, close to 3 trillion including interest on the debt and veterans' care, while the global economic cost of post-9/11 American wars is put at more than 5 trillion dollars. United Nations assessments in 2021 put Taliban fighter deaths at roughly 50,000 to 55,000, and Northern Alliance and Afghan government force losses at about 10,000 to 14,000. With the last Americans leaving on 30 August 2021, the war had run for nearly two decades and became the longest conflict in American history.
cause: 起因要從蘇聯撤軍說起。一九八九年蘇聯完成撤出，冷戰結束留下的縫隙由美國與巴基斯坦扶持的穆吉赫丁接管，一九九三年內戰再起；一九九六年九月塔利班攻入喀布爾，以伊斯蘭法治國，禁止女童上學、逼令少數族群改信，製造出大批持武的部族反對者。一九九八年八月美國駐東非使館爆炸後，美國開始以巡弋飛彈與轟炸機打擊塔利班目標，這場飛彈戰一直延續到九一一之前。二〇〇一年九月十一日，基地組織劫持四架客機，兩架撞上世貿中心雙塔，一架撞五角大樓，一架墜落賓州，兩千九百七十七人罹難；塔利班掌握本·拉登卻拒絕交人，僵持三週後，聯合國安理會第九百九十七號決議要求塔利班引渡，違者視為授權使用武力。二〇〇一年十月一日，美國最後通牒到期，隨後的持久自由行動便是執行安理會授權與自衛權利的聯合軍事行動，塔利班在伊斯蘭法庭上拒絕接受令狀。
causeEn: The causes begin with the Soviet withdrawal. After the Soviets finished pulling out in 1989, the vacuum left by the end of the Cold War was filled by the mujahideen backed by the United States and Pakistan; the civil war of 1993 followed, and in September 1996 the Taliban took Kabul and ruled by Islamic law, banning girls from school and forcing religious minorities to convert, which armed thousands of tribal opponents. After the US embassy bombings in East Africa in August 1998, American cruise missiles and bombers began striking Taliban targets, a missile war that ran right up to 9/11. On 11 September 2001 al-Qaeda hijacked four airliners: two struck the World Trade Center towers, one hit the Pentagon and one came down in Pennsylvania, killing 2,977 people. The Taliban held Osama bin Laden but refused to surrender him, and after three weeks of deadlock United Nations Security Council Resolution 997 demanded his handover on pain of being deemed to have given the Council authority to use force. On 1 October 2001 the American ultimatum expired, and Operation Enduring Freedom followed as a joint military action executed under that Council authorization and the right of self-defence, with the Taliban rejecting the warrant at their Islamic court.
impact: 影響極深：二〇〇一年十一月底塔利班失去喀布爾，十二月《波士頓協議》成立以卡扎伊為主席的臨時政府，二〇〇四年制憲，二〇〇九年首次總統選舉，這套制度在二〇一四年尚能運作，其後持續惡化。北約自二〇〇三年成立國際安全援助部隊，二〇一四年撤出戰鬥任務，二〇一五年果斷支援只訓練不參戰，二〇一九年訓練顧問協助把主動權交回阿國安全部隊，而美軍在二〇一七至二〇一九年一度增兵至近一萬五千人。國家隊伍方面，阿富汗國民軍與警察膨脹至三十萬人以上，裝備美製M4與M16、俄製AK與T-55、T-62、T-72、M249與PKM，但士官培訓與後勤自給能力長期不足。戰局上，二〇一五年後塔利班攻勢節奏加快，到二〇二〇年聯合國評估其控制或威脅的定居點增至約五千個、超過全國一半人口；同時鴉片產量由二〇〇〇年的三千多噸升到二〇一七年的九千噸左右，佔全球產量九成。戰爭最終以二〇二一年八月十五日塔利班進入喀布爾、九月初成立伊斯蘭酋長國告終，二十年的部署、逾兩兆美元開支與數千條性命都沒有換來一個可持續的結局。
impactEn: The consequences ran deep. The Taliban lost Kabul in late November 2001, the December 2001 Bonn Agreement created an interim government chaired by Karzai, a constitution followed in 2004 and the first presidential election in 2009, a system that still functioned in 2014 and then declined steadily. NATO formed the International Security Assistance Force in 2003, ended its combat mission in 2014, kept only a training mission under Resolute Support in 2015, and in 2019 handed the initiative back to Afghan forces with Train Advise Assist, though the United States added troops to nearly 15,000 in 2017 and 2019. The Afghan army and police expanded to more than 300,000 men equipped with American M4s and M16s, Russian AKs and T-55, T-62 and T-72 tanks, M249s and PKMs, but their NCO pipeline and logistics self-sufficiency remained weak. On the ground the Taliban offensive accelerated after 2015; by 2020 United Nations assessments counted some five thousand settlements under Taliban control or threat, more than half the country by population, while opium output rose from just over 3,000 tonnes in 2000 to around 9,000 tonnes in 2017, about ninety per cent of world production. The war ended with the Taliban entering Kabul on 15 August 2021 and declaring an Islamic Emirate in early September: two decades of deployments, more than two trillion dollars and thousands of dead bought no sustainable outcome.
result: 結果分三層看。作戰層面，二〇〇一年至二〇〇二年聯軍與北方聯盟在十個月內摧毀塔利班的常備軍、機場與重武器，多名塔利班高層被擊斃或被俘，其中二〇〇二年三月蟒蛇行動在沙伊-科特山谷抓獲數百名俘虜、迫使殘部投降；但塔利班並未被消滅，而是退入南部鄉村與普什圖部落地區，轉以游擊戰延續，成為二〇〇五至二〇〇七年坎大哈與南部攻勢、二〇〇九年克納爾戰役、二〇一〇年坎大哈攻勢的行動核心。政治層面，二〇一四年北約結束戰鬥任務、二〇一五年只留下訓練任務、二〇二〇年二月二十九日美國與塔利班在多哈達成協議，外國大規模派兵的法律與政治框架就此終結。最終結果是聯軍全面撤出：二〇二一年八月三十日最後一批美軍離開喀布爾機場，塔利班八月十五日進城、九月七日組閣；而二〇二一年七月三十一日基地組織領袖扎瓦希里在喀布爾被美軍無人機擊殺，說明組織本身並未隨戰爭結束而消失。這場戰爭在物理上是聯軍推進、機關槍與防護車輛的勝利，在結構上則是一次沒有戰勝宣告的長期消耗。
resultEn: The result has three layers. Operationally, within ten months the coalition and the Northern Alliance destroyed the Taliban's regular army, its airfields and its heavy weapons, and many Taliban leaders were killed or captured, among them several hundred prisoners taken during Operation Anaconda in the Shah-i-Kot valley in March 2002, when the survivors surrendered. The Taliban, however, was not destroyed: it withdrew into the southern countryside and the Pashtun tribal belt and continued as an insurgency, becoming the engine behind the 2005-2007 offensives in Kandahar and the south, the 2009 battle in Kunar, and the 2010 Kandahar offensive. Politically, NATO ended its combat mission in 2014, kept only a training mission in 2015, and on 29 February 2020 the United States and the Taliban signed the Doha agreement, closing the chapter on the large-scale foreign deployment. The final result was the coalition's complete withdrawal: the last Americans left Kabul airport on 30 August 2021, the Taliban entered the city on 15 August and formed a government on 7 September, and on 31 July 2021 al-Qaeda leader Ayman al-Zawahiri was killed by an American drone strike in Kabul, showing that the organization itself did not disappear with the war. Tactically the war was won by coalition advance, machine guns and mine-resistant vehicles; structurally it was a long attritional fight with no declaration of victory.
